release_notes: Faster dictation — D1 checks now run while you speak, not after
No more slow first dictation after launch — voice model pre-warmed on startup
Prevents idle latency spikes — Whisper kept hot between dictations
Paste history: copy any entry with one click, filter by date
Upgraded to Whisper large-v3-turbo — more accurate, fewer hallucinations
Faster audio upload — switched to Opus encoding (~2× smaller than FLAC)
